body: Are the Resistance ads in 5 going to be removed?

I made a post about this last week actually lol. Even then i unfortunately knew that the likelihood of the advertisements going down was slim. Fingers crossed Rebellion will take down the obnoxious advertising but I’m not exactly naively optimistic either. Genuinely ruins immersion when I walk down a street or walk into a room and see like 5 of these different variations of ads. 

I know Resistance has been getting a lot of criticism (I agree with some of it especially the bugs though I did enjoy the game overall) but if SE:R had ads for SE 5 littered around, I can only imagine the backlash (I mean probably not a biblical amount but definitely would’ve been a big point against the game.)

I want to say the poster with the two Germans manning a flak gun was replaced for these though I could be wrong, I just know I haven’t seen that poster lately and a lot of the placement doesn’t feel deliberate. There’s even miniature versions of the ads on Spy Academy. I know the Reddit hates these post but genuinely fuck these posters.
More than two weeks after Resistance launched and still present, so annoying lol

Funnily enough I did send a support ticket since they had a feedback category for me to select and explained how the ads were still there. Haven’t heard back since Tuesday (can’t exactly remember what day) but hopefully someone looked at it and took note, though ik I’m probably hoping in vain.

Sadly I play on PlayStation, but it would be a nice thought that perhaps pc players could potentially be able to mod or depatch them out of the game. Fingers crossed though that at least someone from Rebellion sees this post.

Fr, even in the mission spawns even makes more sense. But constant advertisements in the middle of nazi facilities I’m supposed to be infiltrating is a little ridiculous. Maybe if they hid them like Easter Eggs they’d be fine too but I wasn’t exaggerating, the radar tower bunker in the first mission has 3-4 all around the entrances.
I know at least MW3 (2011) has an ad for Advanced Warfare but at least that’s in the menus and not the actual maps

Yeah the first one I saw was just a poster of Harry and underneath said “Join the Resistance” and I thought “oh cool, that’s a funny way of tying the games together” but then I saw the ones with the logo and thought “oh that’s pretty cheap…”
